summary: A vertical comparison poster shows the accepted C1Splus cargo scooter in the upper color scene on a sunny seaside boardwalk, ridden by one adult woman with a dog seated inside the central cargo enclosure. Large marketing text promotes the upper scene. A diagonal white divider separates a lower black-and-white comparison scene showing another adult woman walking a dog on a leash in a park-like setting.

persons.observedAppearance: Adult woman in the upper scene, smiling, wearing an orange cap, orange sleeveless top, light beige shorts, and light-colored sneakers, seated on the scooter with both hands on the handlebar.
Adult woman in the lower scene, grayscale, neutral to tired expression, wearing a sleeveless top and fitted pants, walking while holding a dog leash.

softFeatures.composition: 4:5 vertical split-comparison layout; upper larger color lifestyle scene and lower smaller grayscale comparison scene, separated by a white diagonal divider descending from left to right.
softFeatures.sceneLightColor: Upper scene uses warm late-afternoon sunlight with bright natural color; lower scene is desaturated grayscale with softer, subdued contrast.
softFeatures.peoplePetsStory: Upper scene presents a cheerful rider commuting with a dog safely seated in the scooter’s central cabin; lower scene presents a more tiring alternative of a woman walking a dog.
softFeatures.propsOcclusion: Rider legs partially overlap and occlude parts of the scooter midsection naturally; the dog overlaps only the central enclosure area; some lower-scene subjects are partially cropped by the frame edges.
softFeatures.graphicsText: Large bold black headline at upper left, green rounded 'Ours' label with black supporting copy at upper right, red rounded 'Other' label and white supporting copy in the lower section.
softFeatures.effects: Clean commercial compositing, mild depth separation, warm sunlight flare/glow in the upper right, no heavy motion effects visible.
softFeatures.rendering: Photorealistic premium e-commerce style. The seven-dimension breakdown is only partly applicable here because some dimensions concern editable style choices rather than fixed product facts.
